show.description_secondary: She built him in silence and loved him without revealing her true power, only to return from Dubai and be mistaken for a waitress by a charming rival CEO who proposes a fake marriage she refuses. When her gold-digger fiancé humiliates her publicly, that same man steps in, rescues her, and chooses love despite his family’s opposition. As the world waits to meet the mysterious Sky Queen of the Deemar Group, she finally reveals her identity, flips the power dynamic, and delivers a ruthless comeback to the man who underestimated her.
